text.en:
Section 3 of Republic Act No. 4569 is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Sec. 3. No newspaper or periodical shall charge for the publication of said notices and announcements less
than ten pesos per column inch, nor more than eighty percent of their regular commercial display advertising

All laws, decrees, acts, rules and regulations inconsistent herewith are hereby repealed or
modified accordingly.
Done in the City of Manila, this 4th day of September, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-five.
